title: The Moon Climbs Nancy's Mountain
skyStory: Here comes the moon, ninety percent full, hiking straight into Capricorn, Nancy's own sign. It arrives with sensible boots, a thermos and a deep respect for elevation. Capricorn is the mountain goat, steady on cliffs that make everyone else dizzy. Saturn, who rules Capricorn, has tidied the whole summit. There are fresh towels. There is a welcome mat. Mars wipes its feet for once.

reading: The moon is visiting Nancy's sign, and the cabin feels it as a kind of quiet steadiness. You'll find yourself finishing things today instead of starting them. Your inner Capricorn neighbour has come over and is helping you clean the gutters, metaphorically.

Use the Capricorn moon to build something that lasts: fix the wobbly step, finally label the toolbox, write down how you like the cabin set up for summer. Around 4 pm, switch the onyx to your right wrist and send Nancy a jolt of strength. It's her moon. She's earned some extra wind in her sails.
joel.mission: Switch the onyx to your right wrist this afternoon to send Nancy strength, and tell her you did.
joel.omen: Anything that climbs steadily: a squirrel, a vine, a slow cyclist. Slow climbing wins the summit.

reading: Presents have arrived on the mountain: the moon is in your sign, and it delivered them personally. You'll feel taller today, steadier, as if the mountain inside you got a fresh coat of snow on its peak and a sunrise to show it off.

Something you've been pushing uphill finally reaches a ledge where you can rest and look back. Look back. See how far you've come. The [[Knight of Pentacles]] reversed reminds you not to turn this into another reason to work harder; stand on the ledge and enjoy the view. This afternoon you'll feel a little jolt of warmth near your pinky. That's Joel switching wrists.
nancy.mission: Find the highest point near you, a hill, a staircase or a lookout, and stand on it for two minutes looking out.
nancy.omen: Your ruby catching the light at an angle you've never noticed. Strength is arriving from across the distance.
nancy.stoneWhy: Joel's stone, glowing with sent strength

together.text: The moon is in Nancy's sign. Today Joel sends strength by switching his onyx to the right wrist, and Nancy confirms receipt by holding up her pinky like a toast. Send each other a photo of the gesture. The mountain hears, and so does the cabin.

game.intro: The moon is climbing Nancy's mountain. Carry three tales up the trail and hide one fib in the backpack.
game.prompt: Three places you have stood that had a great view. One is pure fiction.
